title: Luxuriously Layered French Lentil Gratin
description: A rich and festive French dish featuring the deep flavors of pomegranate molasses and the subtle smokiness of binchotan-charcoal, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the lentils and enough water to cover them, then bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the lentils for 20 minutes, or until they are tender.
In a large skillet, heat the binchotan-charcoal infused oil over medium heat, then add the chopped onion and cook until it is softened.
Add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the pomegranate molasses, thyme, and bay leaves, then cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked lentils, the skillet mixture, and the shredded gruyere cheese, then season with salt and pepper to taste.
Transfer the lentil mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish, then top with the freshly grated bread crumbs and dot with the butter.
Bake the gratin in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until it is golden brown and the bread crumbs are crispy.
